name: ui-state-machine-view
description: StateMachineView — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui state-machine-view pattern).

schema.description: StateMachineView — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui state-machine-view pattern).
schema.name: ui-state-machine-view

activeTransition.description: `index` of the transition that just fired.
activeTransition.label: Active Transition

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

entityFields.description: Entity field names listed in the header.
entityFields.label: Entity Fields

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

onTransitionClick.description: Direct transition-click callback, for React hosts (e.g. a canvas node).
onTransitionClick.label: On Transition Click

pendingSourceState.description: Source of a transition being drawn — the next state click picks its target.
pendingSourceState.label: Pending Source State

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

selectedState.description: State picked in an editor (first click).
selectedState.label: Selected State

showHeader.description: Show the trait header (name, entity, listens/emits). @default true
showHeader.label: Show Header

stateClickEvent.description: Emits UI:{stateClickEvent} with { stateId } when a state is clicked.
stateClickEvent.label: State Click Event

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

transitionClickEvent.description: Emits UI:{transitionClickEvent} with { index, event, from, to } when a transition label is clicked.
transitionClickEvent.label: Transition Click Event

visitedStates.description: States already passed through, in order.
visitedStates.label: Visited States

emits.description: Emits UI:{stateClickEvent} with { stateId } when a state is clicked.
Emits UI:{transitionClickEvent} with { index, event, from, to } when a transition label is clicked.

events.description: Emits UI:{stateClickEvent} with { stateId } when a state is clicked.
events.name: @config.state click event

events.description: Emits UI:{transitionClickEvent} with { index, event, from, to } when a transition label is clicked.
events.name: @config.transition click event
